Answer.description: The response to a learner's question as the learner reads it: never a proposal, a decision or a state.
Answer.title: Answer

Assessment.description: An assessment as the learner sees it (D20): never its answer key.
Assessment.title: Assessment

AttemptSubmission.description: The learner's attempt at one activity, under the learner's own request id.
AttemptSubmission.title: AttemptSubmission

Competence.description: An ALM ``Topic`` that a learning outcome addresses; the studio shows it as a competence.
Competence.title: Competence

CourseView.description: The validated course of a delivery as its learners see it (D20).
CourseView.title: CourseView

Evaluation.description: An evaluation of the learner's evidence that a person approved and applied.
Evaluation.title: Evaluation

Evidence.description: What the learner handed in, as it was observed.
Evidence.title: Evidence

resolution.default: Correct the data or provide the required configuration.
resolution.title: Resolution

Judgment.description: One rubric criterion of an applied evaluation: its level (none when undetermined) and the reason.
Judgment.title: Judgment

LearnerCourse.description: A course the learner is enrolled in: its delivery context and the name of its learning design.
LearnerCourse.title: LearnerCourse

LearningState.description: The learner's state for one outcome, derived only from applied evaluations.
LearningState.title: LearningState

Material.description: A resource bound to this delivery by a reviewed binding the learner may read.
Material.title: Material

Node.description: A phase or unit of the syllabus, with its activities and the parts directly inside it, in order.
Node.title: Node

Occurrence.description: One of the learner's attempts at an activity.
Occurrence.title: Occurrence

Question.description:
A learner's question: to the Teacher (``EXPLAIN``) or to the Socratic coach (``SOCRATIC_GUIDANCE``).

The coach follows Socratic option b: its worker may read sources that hold the solution, and only what it
returns is judged. A problem stays with the coach until the learner switches from it explicitly.
Question.title: Question

QuestionList.description: The learner's own questions in a course, newest first.
QuestionList.title: QuestionList

QuestionRequest.description: A question under the learner's own request id.
QuestionRequest.title: QuestionRequest

QuestionView.description: A learner's question: its status and, once its run has ended, the response or the reason it has none.
QuestionView.title: QuestionView

Strategy.description: A teaching strategy of the course.
Strategy.title: Strategy
